title: Inspector smoke payload — minimal valid input for the lean ★ elementor.widget.insert tool
_comment: WP-Q03 — Inspector smoke (14-fixtures-harness.md §8; 13-tool-catalog.md §5.2 #11, §1.3). widget.insert is MUTATING (class M; transactional, optimistic-lock + idempotency guarded; proxied-to-REST POST documents/{id}/elements) — so it targets the SHARED DISPOSABLE DRAFT, never a real page. Gated on v4 atomic (requires.experiments e_atomic_elements). The driver substitutes the live `{{DRAFT_POST_ID}}`, the root container `{{DRAFT_PARENT_ID}}`, and the fresh `{{DRAFT_BASE_HASH}}` (re-read after setup; S02/R5 — local-style/element ids are NOT stable across save, so base_hash is always re-read, never cached). MINIMAL valid input per §1.3: REQUIRED {post_id, parent_id, node, base_hash} (index/op_id/force optional). `node` is a STRICTLY-TYPED atomic heading ([R8]). The §8 suite asserts no protocol error (-326xx) and a result matching the outputSchema {diff, inserted_id, base_hash}.
